posts.note: Community-powered shipping — senders get matched with travelers already heading their way.
posts.about: CrowdWave connects people who need to send a package with travelers who have spare space on a route they're already taking. Senders post package details and destination, travelers post their route, and a matching algorithm pairs them in real time. Senders save up to 70% versus traditional couriers, travelers earn on each delivery, and the shipment produces no extra vehicle trip. Trust runs on government-ID verification, two-way ratings, encrypted payments, and real-time tracking with photo proof of delivery. Free to register as a sender. iOS and Android.
posts.author: Iona
